description: Specification of all Inno Setup constants (e.g. {app}, {win}, {reg:...}) used by the plugin for completion, validation and documentation.

constants.description: List of all constants that can be used inside an Inno Setup script.

fileTargets.description: Set of file types a rule applies to: "iss" (script) and/or "isl" (language file).

constant.description: A single Inno Setup constant that expands to a path or value at install time.

name.description: Constant name as written in the script without braces (e.g. "app", "win", "sys").

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what the constant expands to, shown in documentation and tooltips.

deprecated.description: File types in which this constant is deprecated (e.g. ["iss", "isl"]). Empty = not deprecated.

type.description: Category of the constant: "directory"/"shell_folder" for path constants, "auto" for context-dependent (user/common) constants, "special" for non-path constants, or "parameterized" for constants taking an argument.

parameterized.description: Whether the constant takes an inline parameter (e.g. {reg:...}, {param:...}).

syntax.description: Full usage syntax of the constant including any parameters (e.g. "{reg:HKxx\\SubkeyName,ValueName|DefaultValue}").

since.description: Inno Setup version in which this constant was introduced (e.g. "6.0.0").

until.description: Inno Setup version up to which this constant is supported; absent if still current.
